newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - NORMA H1 PROFIT 59.4 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - NORMA H1 PROFIT 59.4 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Norma, the diversified industrialist, said on Tuesday that its preliminary net profit for the first six months was 59.4 million kroons and its net turnover was 241.1 million kroons.
Norma will release its final half-year figures on July 30, the company added in a statement.
Norma's finance director Peep Pihotalo told Reuters the figures were stable and good compared to previous months.
Its June profit was 7.1 million kroons according to preliminary figures.
"Sales have been as good as before and the dollar exchange rate has been continuously favourable for us," Pihotalo said.
